data.title: Drift opens exploit recovery claims with initial payouts of just over 1% of user losses
data.summary_raw: DFX holders can cash out now or wait for more funding, with no firm timeline for full repayment.

data.title: Paradigm-backed Layer 2 Blast to wind down network as costs exceed revenue
data.summary_raw: Ethereum L2 Blast is winding down after costs outpaced revenue. Users have until Oct. 26 to withdraw via the app.

data.summary_raw: Bitcoin climbed back toward $87,000 on Friday as sellers cleared out around $85,000, according to Glassnode.

data.title: BitGo CEO says Clarity’s failure left capital markets exposed to risk potentially worse than Lehman
data.summary_raw: BitGo CEO Mike Belshe warned that Clarity's failure left systemic risks arising from one firm holding exchange, brokerage, and custody functions.
